purpose: Keep rich host binary-size gates separate from pure/tiny edge viability claims so the pragmatic 35 MB host gate cannot become proof that InfRing runs on constrained hardware.

profiles.claim_scope: Host/developer/release binary remains bounded enough for ordinary machines.
Constrained hardware viability requires a separate tiny/pure profile, artifact, budget, and proof pack.
required_future_evidence: separate tiny/pure binary or package artifact
release proof-pack entry distinct from rich_host_static

invariants: 35 MB gates are rich_host_static gates only.
A passing rich_host_static gate is not tiny_pure_edge proof.
tiny_pure_edge promotion requires a separate budget and evidence artifact.
Release notes must identify the 35 MB binary as rich-host static, not generic constrained-device proof.
